capsule_v1_to_v2.scope: Manifest-record comparison confirms only these five metadata/schema/sealer payload records changed; raw runtime receipts, histories, input files, target captures, logs and plans retain original declared byte pins. No payload-sized repeat hash or model rerun by reviewer.

resolved_findings.resolution: Metadata-only capsule v2 adds required_inputs with all99 offered forecast references; verifier matches the exact byte-key multiset to WRF child input_paths. Original v1 remains untouched.

V2 source manifest explicitly separates regular8139 from tracked symlinks17; verifier authenticates clean Git head/tree, complete roster and symlink literal target/Gitblob without following unused vendor links. Bundled representation also uses Gitmode120000 handling rather than premature rejection.

Each child has an input_plan reference. Plan kind, executable byte pins/install-root path, ordered capsule input paths and table-link byte multiset are bound to offered child inputs. WRF has6capsule inputs+93table links; ideal5+93. Four required RRTMGP table link names and capture flags are checked.
Child/process joins bind actualRC0/reaped/no timeout, PID/time/argv/cwd/environment/processgroup and executable pre/post SHA/size. Runtime arm process fields are bound to the same WRF process.

Validation sourcehead/tree/history exact reference and LW/SW selected-layer dictionaries join identity/runtime; forecast namelist.output is selected by WRFcwd and compared to expected domain policy. Report and identity must keep physical_status NOT_ACCEPTED.

tests_and_verification.note: Author results are message-reported; no root independent verification outcome is presumed. The reviewer read control definitions and actual small JSON joins, without running verifier or compiler.

limitations: This certifies source/schema/relationship checks in exact reviewed bytes, not a fresh full-byte rehash of all external roots or every capsule payload. Root will perform independent once verification.
Trust-anchor SHA must come from outside the capsule to detect coordinated rewriting of manifest+payload; README documents the optional expected-manifest digest.

Offered table/input roster is a superset supplied to the runtime; it is not an OS file-open provenance trace. Installed libraries/tool data are byte references, not proof of all internal dynamic loading/physical semantics.
Selected-layer validation is joined to the saved original report; this verifier does not recompute precipitation optics, independently establish Nc/PSD authority or certify physical accuracy.
Same one ideal+one forecast are retained. No new runtime execution is created by metadata-only v2 or this review.
Whole-port serial storage-kind failure is separate integration evidence; this scoped exactfe8 capsule verdict does not waive it or rewrite other checklist snapshots.
